clients.name: Consent replay web app
clients.description: The consent graph's ordinary client (graphs/flows/core/consent). Replay fixture: never seed it into a deployment that serves real users.

clients.name: Consent replay agent
clients.description: The consent graph's agent client, capped at the readonly mode, so a request for agent:exec is above its cap. Replay fixture: never seed it into a deployment that serves real users.

clients.name: Consent replay client with a plain-http redirect
clients.description: The consent graph's client whose registered redirect URI is plain http to a host that is not loopback, which no environment permits. Replay fixture: never seed it into a deployment that serves real users.

clients.name: Consent replay development client
clients.description: The consent graph's development client: its scenario sets oauth_clients.environment to development and the realm's ceiling to match, which the manifest cannot. Replay fixture: never seed it into a deployment that serves real users.
